verdict.rationale: Bolt documents starting from a blank prompt and building an app with no code required. It also documents running Node.js servers, built-in database and email authentication, Supabase and Stripe integrations, and built-in hosting, so prompts lead to a deployable full-stack app; community users report going from idea to prod in a day. Some hands-on reports describe errors and fix-break loops on more complex builds, which lowers reliability but does not negate the documented capability. Missing for 10: consistent independent evidence that generated full-stack apps work reliably beyond simple projects, and documented depth of backend generation outside the Bolt Database/Supabase setup.

support.subject: As a founder, I can describe an app in natural language and get a working full-stack application

citations.quote: Anyone can start from a blank prompt, upload files to build with, or import designs from Figma or Google Stitch.
Build your first website or app with Bolt: no code required.
Bolt makes it easy to add database functionality to your app without the hassle of extra infrastructure.
Bolt offers built-in hosting, so you can publish your Bolt project for free at a web address ending in `bolt.host`.
i've seen people literally go from idea to prod in a day when it normally would take a week.
